description: This is a test class for the DateUtils utility class, containing unit tests for date-related calculations such as week number of the year, weeks left in the year, and date comparisons (current year, future date). It uses Mockito for mocking static methods and AssertJ for assertions.

classes.name: DateUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DateUtils utility methods related to date calculations and comparisons.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mocks for static methods in DateUtils.TimeUtils before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the static mock after all tests.

methods.name: mockFirstWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to the first week of 2020 and returns the week number.

methods.name: mockFortiethWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to the 40th week of 2020 and returns the week number.

methods.name: mockLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to the last week of 2020 and returns the week number.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Tests that the week number calculation returns expected values for the first, 40th, and last week of the year.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Tests calculation of weeks remaining in the year from various current week numbers.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests whether dates are correctly identified as being in the current year.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Tests whether dates are correctly identified as being in the future.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYear
methods.description: Helper method to compute remaining weeks in the year based on current week number.
